_comment: Coverage ratchet baseline (scripts/coverage_report.py --check). union_binding_*, cells_live and template_cell_liveness_bp may not DECREASE; dead_cells and never_evaluated_rules may not INCREASE. Update only after a deliberate, recorded improvement — never to clear a red gate. READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING A GREEN: cells_live is the cell-coverage floor. template_cell_liveness_bp is a RATIO whose denominator shrinks with its numerator and dead_cells is declared-minus-live, so both can IMPROVE while coverage is destroyed — measured, deleting the b31/rich run loses 689 live cells while moving liveness 1285->1374bp and dead 55553->47123. Only cells_live and the binding-rule counts fail on that. Separately, every metric is a UNION over the portfolio x regime matrix recorded in provenance, so growing RUNS makes dead_cells RISE and template_cell_liveness_bp FALL by declaring cells no portfolio fills yet; on a matrix change --check reports the comparison as INVALID rather than as a regression, and the right response is to re-measure and bank the new matrix with the reason in _note — never to drop a portfolio so the old numbers fit again.
_note: Re-banked 2026-09-05 over the 24-run matrix, recording the FS-1 facility-share reporting portfolio (tests/fixtures/facility_share_portfolio.py, registered as RUNS entries 21-24: crr/facility-share-binding, crr/facility-share-nonbinding, b31/facility-share-binding, b31/facility-share-nonbinding) added by batch facility-share-fanout-20260905, the first registered portfolio whose Basel 3.1 output floor BINDS. WHAT MOVED: cells_live 8724 -> 8728 (+4), template_cell_liveness_bp 1364 -> 1365, dead_cells 55237 -> 55233 (-4). EVERY RULE METRIC IS UNCHANGED: union_binding_rules_crr 263, union_binding_rules_b31 313, never_evaluated_rules 785. The two ERROR rules this portfolio newly FAILS (b31/boe_b0751, b31/boe_b0763 - col 0260 vs the sum of cols 0251-0254, off by exactly the floor shortfall) were already binding (PASSing) on other runs, so the union count does not rise; they are banked in validation_known_breaks.json under OWNER: P1.369 and their account is in that register's REGISTER_NOTES. cells_declared is unchanged (the portfolio declares no new column; its sheets are corporate ones the estate already declared), so the +4 is straight liveness, not a matrix-growth artefact. MEASUREMENT PROVENANCE: the engine diff on this branch is the facility-share candidate fan-out (hierarchy) and the pre-floor resolver (aggregator) - no reporting golden moved across the batch, the 20 prior runs are untouched, and live is a union accumulator so no live cell can have gone dead across the growth; none did. --- PREVIOUS BANK'S NOTE, RETAINED --- Re-banked 2026-09-05 over the 20-run matrix, recording the netting reporting portfolio (tests/fixtures/reporting_netting_portfolio.py, registered as RUNS entries 19-20, crr/netting + b31/netting) added to PR #487 (fix/on-bs-netting-agreement-perimeter) to close the coverage gap that PR recorded: no registered portfolio carried an on-balance-sheet netting agreement at all, let alone one spanning counterparties. WHAT MOVED: union_binding_rules_b31 312 -> 313 (+1). The one rule is boe_b0555 (OF 07.00 collateral / exposure-value relation), which left the vacuity population in validation_known_breaks.json on the same change and now asserts and PASSES - the two measurements agree, as they did for the 2026-08-27 bank. EVERY OTHER RATCHETED METRIC IS UNCHANGED: union_binding_rules_crr 263, cells_live 8724, template_cell_liveness_bp 1364, dead_cells 55237, never_evaluated_rules 785. cells_live NOT moving deserves a sentence: the companion template-cell census (scripts/template_cell_coverage_baseline.json) DID move corep/c07_00/0035 from dead (NO_FIXTURE: 'no fixture supplies a netting agreement') to live, 239 -> 240 live columns of 339, so the portfolio lights the column it was built for; this script's cell census is a union over cells already declared by other runs and the netting portfolio's corporate sheet declares no cell the estate had not already declared, so the union floor does not rise. Read the two censuses together, not this one alone. WHAT ELSE THIS BANK CARRIES, deliberately and not as an improvement: the SAME registration exposed a pre-existing Basel 3.1 C 07.00 defect - the netted deposit is deducted in col 0035 AND again inside col 0130 (the Art. 219 synthetic cash collateral is summed into the financial-collateral column), so c0150 reads 16,000,000 against a correct c0200 of 19,000,000 on the netting corporate sheet. TWO NEW ENTRIES IN known_broken_rules accompany this bank: b31/boe_b0471 (ERROR, the c0200 = c0150 - CCF-bucket derivation) and b31/boe_b0556 (WARNING, c0200 <= c0150), both attributed to that mechanism in their reasons, both independent of the perimeter change (the Feature-disabled run shows the same gap), recorded in docs/development/escape-log.md 2026-09-05 (class path-never-exercised, verified red). The fix (a sealed post-haircut on_bs_netting_adjusted_value carrier reported in 0035 and excluded from 0130) is deferred to its own change; when it lands the two entries leave the register and this note's successor should say so. MEASUREMENT PROVENANCE: the engine diff on this branch is the netting-perimeter change already committed (fda87d69); the matrix growth is 18 -> 20 runs with the 18 prior runs untouched, so a live cell cannot have gone dead across it (live is a union accumulator), and none did. --- PREVIOUS BANK'S NOTE, RETAINED --- Re-banked 2026-08-31 for the C 08.03 post-CRM PD row axis (fix/c0803-post-crm-pd-banding). THIS BANK RECORDS A SMALL NET LOSS ON THE CELL CENSUS AND NOTHING ELSE: cells_live 8728 -> 8724 (-4), template_cell_liveness_bp 1365 -> 1364, dead_cells 55233 -> 55237 (+4). EVERY RULE METRIC IS BYTE-IDENTICAL - union_binding_rules_crr 263, union_binding_rules_b31 312, never_evaluated_rules 785, rules_enforced_crr 741, rules_enforced_b31 808 - so no published validation rule lost or gained binding. cells_declared is UNCHANGED at 63961 and the matrix is UNCHANGED at the same 18 runs, so this is neither a matrix-growth bank nor a declared-set change; it is a straight -4 on the cell-coverage floor and is banked as such rather than dressed up as an improvement. WHAT MOVED, PER REGIME (identical under CRR and Basel 3.1): 5 cells live -> dead and 3 dead -> live, netting -2 per regime. The 5 losses are all cells that CANNOT hold a value at their new coordinates. Four are retail_other r0070/r0090 x c0030/c0080: c0030 is the average CCF on the ORIGIN basis weighted by off-balance-sheet gross, and retail_other is an inflow-only sheet in the crm-substitution portfolio with no origin legs at all, so there is no gross to weight; c0080 is bound to a constant null on every retail sheet because PS1/26 Annex II forbids reporting maturity for the retail exposure class. The fifth is institution r0040 c0030, the same origin-basis-CCF-on-an-arrived-row case. WHY THOSE COORDINATES ARE NEW: the change bands the post-CRM column block on the post-CRM PD, and S2's arrived retail_other leg re-bands from the borrower's 0.60% (leaf row 0060, a band that stands alone) to the guarantor's 2.00% (leaf row 0090 PLUS its parent row 0070). One row became two because the post-CRM band happens to fall inside a parent-having region of the hierarchical scale, and the second row brings its two structurally-null columns with it. THESE FOUR CELLS ARE UNFILLABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, so the usual and better response to a cells_live regression - add fixture coverage that lights them - is not available here: no portfolio can put origin off-BS gross on a sheet that has no origin legs, and no portfolio can make a constant-null binding return a number. WHAT WAS VERIFIED BEFORE BANKING, because cells_live is the floor and a -4 on it must not be waved through: (1) a NATIVE retail_other origin leg at PD 2.00% carrying 1000 of off-BS gross and CCF 0.40 still emits rows 0070 AND 0090 with c0030 = 0.4000 live on both, so the sparser per-basis row-presence test has NOT stopped emitting a row that has genuine origin exposure - that was the one failure mode that would have made this a real regression rather than a coordinate shift; (2) no golden moved; (3) sheet totals are unchanged, the change redistributes rows only; (4) the full estate is green including tests/oracle and tests/acceptance/reporting. WHAT WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, recorded rather than guessed: the 3 gains per regime (institution r0060/r0070/r0080 c0030, dead -> live) are NOT attributable from this artifact, because cells are unioned across the 18 runs and the JSON carries no per-run cell census. They are a side effect of the same per-basis row emission and they move in our favour, but the specific run that lights them was not identified and no mechanism for them is asserted here. If a future bank needs that attribution, the gap to close first is per-run cell provenance in coverage_report.py. --- PREVIOUS BANK'S NOTE, RETAINED --- Re-banked 2026-08-27 over the 18-run matrix, recording the irb-shapes portfolio (tests/fixtures/reporting_irb_shapes_portfolio.py, registered as RUNS entries 17-18). EVERY ratcheted metric improved, which is unusual for a matrix growth and is worth explaining rather than just banking: union_binding_rules_crr 257 -> 263 (+6), union_binding_rules_b31 289 -> 312 (+23), cells_live 8353 -> 8680 (+327), template_cell_liveness_bp 1310 -> 1358, dead_cells 55393 -> 55215 (-178), never_evaluated_rules UNCHANGED at 785. The usual caveat in the note below - that growing RUNS makes dead_cells RISE and liveness FALL by declaring cells no portfolio fills yet - does NOT bite here, because this portfolio declares no new template column. It emits sheets the estate already declared (corporate, retail_other, project_finance) and fills columns on them that no run had ever reached, so cells_declared barely moves while live cells rise. THE BINDING-RULE GAIN IS CORROBORATED INDEPENDENTLY: the +6 CRR / +23 B31 split matches EXACTLY the 6 CRR and 23 Basel 3.1 rules that left the vacuity population in the same change (removed from known_vacuous_rules in tests/expected_outputs/reporting/validation_known_breaks.json). A rule leaving VACUOUS becomes PASS or FAIL, which is precisely what union_binding_rules_* counts - two measurements taken by different scripts over different populations agreeing to the rule. Source: one obligor per IRB exposure SHAPE - an issued off-BS item and an undrawn commitment on an IRB corporate, an off-BS leg on a slotting obligor, an apply_fi_scalar LFSE obligor, a defaulted retail_other leg with BEEL strictly below LGD (RWEA 531,250, non-zero, unlike the estate's existing defaulted IRB row whose K = max(0, LGD - BEEL) is exactly 0), a life-policy pledge, and a cash-plus-equity pledge on an F-IRB leg. The companion template-cell census moved 29 column pairs dead -> live (210 -> 239 of 339) over its own 30-run matrix. MEASUREMENT PROVENANCE: src/ is UNTOUCHED by this change - the diff is four files under tests/ plus the two baselines - so no engine behaviour moved and the metric delta is attributable to the new runs alone. The BEFORE template-cell census reproduced the previous bank exactly (339 pairs / 210 live / 129 dead / 4.92% fill) before the portfolio was added, which is what makes that attribution safe. TWO NEW ENTRIES IN known_broken_rules accompany this bank, both published-rule limitations with measured proof under the new notes.pattern_non_additive_columns_in_summation_rules: boe_b0744 (ERROR) and boe_b0346 (WARNING). boe_b0744 is ERROR-severity and therefore submission-rejecting; it is banked on the arithmetic that a DISTINCT obligor count cannot equal a sum of overlapping breakdown rows, and it is flagged in its own reason as a one-line revert if that reading is rejected on review. --- PREVIOUS BANK'S NOTE, RETAINED because its reasoning about provenance and about why cells_live is the floor is still the authority for those fields --- Re-banked 2026-08-09 (SECOND bank of the day) to record a real coverage INCREASE from task 1.4: cells_live 8193 -> 8353 (+160), dead_cells 55553 -> 55393 (-160), template_cell_liveness_bp 1285 -> 1310. cells_declared is UNCHANGED at 63746 - the increment added liveness without declaring anything, which is why dead_cells fell by the full 160 and the ratio moved the right way. Zero cells lost. Source: four new legs on the registered sa-classes reporting portfolio lighting C 07.00 / OF 07.00 risk-weight rungs 0180 (20%) and 0240 (150%) across four sheets, every row identity non-trivially satisfied (c0200 != c0220 on all four; the 150% legs are the first rows in this portfolio where c0220 > c0200). Four ERROR rules moved VACUOUS -> PASS: v0320_m and v0326_m (CRR), boe_b0483 and boe_b0490 (Basel 3.1). union_binding_rules_crr/b31 and never_evaluated_rules are UNCHANGED, and that is expected rather than a disappointment: none of the 36 rung-identity rules was ever NOT_EVALUATED - they were VACUOUS (evaluated, all operands null) - and union_binding_rules_* is a union across runs, so a rule already PASSing on another portfolio is already counted. Neither headline metric can see a VACUOUS -> PASS improvement. The quantity that moved is per-run VACUOUS, which this script records in runs[] and gates on nothing; that gap is filed. Also measured while banking: the rung-identity rules are sheets_scope 'all', one rule per rung per regime, so lighting a rung on a second sheet buys cells but zero extra rules - converting more of the 36 needs more distinct RUNGS, not more portfolios. MEASUREMENT PROVENANCE: every src/**/*.py was hashed before the BEFORE run and after the AFTER run and was identical, and the BEFORE run reproduced the previous bank exactly (8193 / 1285 / 55553 / 785), which independently proves the Art. 121 Table 5 engine work in flight at the time does not move these metrics. --- PREVIOUS BANK'S NOTE, RETAINED because its reasoning about provenance and about why cells_live is the floor is still the authority for those fields --- Re-banked 2026-08-09 over the 16-run matrix. TWO changes, both deliberate. (1) FIRST BANK TO RECORD PROVENANCE. The predecessor was a 12-run measurement taken before the real-estate carrier batch registered re-split x2 and art199 x2 - and of an OLDER TREE: its figures no longer reproduce at either matrix size (re-measuring the 12-run matrix as it stood at the baseline commit gives crr 253 / b31 279 / 1300bp / 52803 dead against the banked 251 / 277 / 1298 / 52817), so those numbers are not a target and cannot be reproduced. dead_cells is banked WORSE in absolute terms (52817 -> 55553) and template_cell_liveness_bp LOWER (1298 -> 1285), and that is a coverage INCREASE, not a loosened gate. What settles it is holding the matrix constant, NOT the direction the metrics moved: cell metrics down while rule metrics up is equally consistent with a real cell loss plus an unrelated rule gain. The decisive figures are absolute - live cells rose 7891 -> 8193 while declared rose 60694 -> 63746, so coverage cannot have fallen. Every one of the 2873 newly-dead cells sits on the C 07.00 / OF 07.00 residential_mortgage sheet, which NO run emitted at 12 and which re-split emits at 16; 123 cells dead at 12 runs are live at 16 (C 07.00 commercial_mortgage, C 09.01 GB/TOTAL); and a live cell CANNOT go dead across a matrix growth because live is a union accumulator over runs and runs 1-12 are identical in both measurements. (2) cells_live ADDED AS THE CELL-COVERAGE FLOOR, banked at 8193. The other two cell numbers are not floors and are sometimes ANTI-signal: liveness is a ratio whose denominator moves with its numerator and dead_cells is declared-minus-live, so dropping declared cells faster than live ones improves both. Measured over all 16 leave-one-out deletions of this matrix: on 4 of 16 BOTH cell metrics moved the passing way while live cells were destroyed - worst is b31/rich, which loses 689 live cells while liveness RISES 1285 -> 1374bp and dead_cells FALLS 55553 -> 47123 (also crr/sa-classes -441, b31/sa-classes -367 with bp -> 1458, b31/re-split -141); on 6 more exactly one of the two passed; only 4 of 16 were caught by both. cells_live fell on all 14 deletions that actually cost live cells and never rose on a loss. The two it did not move for, crr/art199 and b31/art199, cost ZERO live cells - neither contributes a uniquely-live cell, so there was nothing for any cell metric to catch (cells only; that probe did not measure whether those runs are load-bearing for RULE binding). MEASUREMENT PROVENANCE: taken against a pristine `git archive HEAD src` export, not the working tree, because the shared checkout had in-flight engine work at the time (engine/sa/risk_weights.py plus a new engine/sa/sovereign_derived.py - the Art. 121 Table 5 sovereign-derived institution weights). So these numbers describe the COMMITTED engine, which is what the coverage-ratchet CI job measures. Expect the binding-rule counts to RISE when that work lands: --check reports an improvement and exits 0, and banking it is then a normal re-bank. never_evaluated_rules is 785 in every measurement taken.
